addressRegionWins.description: On an address route the region named in the address is used before the region of the system it names, instead of after it.

architectureFacts.description: The dossier lists a system's stellar architecture and station counts, and a planet's designation, orbital host and moon inventory.

bodyRenderOpacity.description: The central body of the local planet chart carries an opacity attribute taken from its renderOpacity (default 1).

bordersToggleClass.description: Hiding map borders toggles the borders-hidden class on the region layer instead of setting its display style.

closeSidebarOnSelect.description: Selecting a system closes the location index drawer on narrow screens.

companionStars.description: A system's companion stars (primaries after the first) are drawn beside its main star.

derivedBelts.description: A system with no beltSlot shows a belt when it has more than two orbits; with a beltSlot, a belt shows when the slot is greater than 0. Without the flag a belt shows only when beltSlot is set.

dimmedBodiesAreFiller.description: Bodies with renderOpacity below 1 get the filler orbit track and no label on the system chart.

elsewhereStations.description: The local-orbit view lists the system's 'register' stations under an 'Elsewhere in the system' heading (and keeps the blank line the layout reserves for it).

emptyDossierFactsFallBack.description: A live dossier whose fact list is empty falls back to the facts built from the catalogue record.

extendedChartMoonThreshold.description: When greater than 0, the local planet chart switches to its extended satellite layout once the planet has more moons than this number; when 0 it follows each world's extendedSatelliteChart field.

fallbackRegion.description: Region shown when an address names no region and no system.

flatStarFill.description: The first star of a system on the system chart is filled with its own tint instead of the shared sun gradient.

focusRegionIgnoresRegion.description: On a focus=region route the region named in the address is ignored and the system's own region is used.

goldenAngleMoonPhase.description: Moons on the local planet chart always start a golden-angle step apart (2.39996 radians), not only in the extended layout (default step 2.1).

hashIgnoredWithRegion.description: The URL hash is ignored when the address names an explicit region (and no system or planet).

hiddenStationFilters.description: Station categories left out of the local-orbit station filter bar (planetView).

hideExtendedHostStations.description: The system chart leaves out stations whose host planet has extendedSatelliteChart; they appear on that planet's own chart.

highlightedRegionState.description: The saved history state and the remembered camera store highlightedRegion instead of the overview flag.

highlightRouteParam.description: The address records the highlighted region as highlight=<region> and never writes chart=, instead of the overview chart parameter.

indexWorldLinks.description: The index lists a system's worlds (its overviewWorlds when present) as article links instead of plain text.

inspectLabelsUseTitles.description: Inspect buttons in the system key are labelled with the synced planet title instead of the catalogue name.

keepStationPart.description: A station screen that is drawn again keeps the highlighted part instead of resetting to the first part.

linkTitleSync.description: Link text shows a planet's synced title: off, worlds (only when the name is a catalogued world) or all (whenever the label equals the name).

minimapRegionPaths.description: The minimap draws each region as a path built from outlines relative to the region bounds, instead of an absolute polygon or rectangle.

minimapViewBox.description: Fixed viewBox for the minimap, for atlases with no atlasExtent; null uses the atlas extent.

noLocalChartFallback.description: An exact system and planet route does not fall back to the local chart parent of the planet.

noOverviewRoute.description: The chart parameter is not read for routing: a region in the address opens its regional chart, never the overview chart.

normalizeTitleApostrophes.description: Article links turn curly apostrophes in a title into straight ones before building the URL.

overviewChart.description: Value of the chart address parameter that selects the overview chart (overview, or federation for Kadaym).

overviewStateKey.description: Name of the saved-state field that records the overview flag (route history and the camera memory).

perSystemLabels.description: System labels are shown per system against the highlighted region, using policies.labels.levels as [name, planet] pairs for active and neighbouring regions.

planetArticleTitles.description: Planet links use the article title kept in sync with the Codex (planetArticleName) when the planet has one.

planetArticleTracking.description: Live article lookups use, and update, the tracked wiki page id of a planet (synced article titles).

planetLinkAttributes.description: Links to planets carry data-planet-link and data-planet-title attributes so the page can find and retitle them.

planetPageLinks.description: Planet links go to the Codex page by page id (curid) once the id is known from title synchronisation.

regionHighlight.description: The whole-atlas chart highlights one region (highlightedRegion) instead of switching between overview and regional charts.

regionLabelStyle.description: How regions are labelled, in drawing and when scaled: ink (Elysian), ink-title (Calidor), title-subtitle-ink (UACS) or title-subtitle-extent (Kadaym).

searchSystemFields.description: Extra system fields (by property name) whose text is searchable, in addition to the classification terms.

selectFirstWorld.description: Selecting a system without naming an object also selects its first catalogued world.

selectKeepsRegion.description: Selecting or opening a system keeps the chart on the region the user chose instead of switching to the system's region.

shortLabelsOnlyWhenExtended.description: Satellite labels on the local planet chart use a body's shortLabel only in the extended layout; otherwise they always use it.

sizedFocusBodyLabel.description: Satellite labels on the local planet chart carry an explicit font-size (smaller in the extended layout).

solarIllustrativeGuard.description: Only add an illustrative planet when its kind exists in illustrativeTypes, instead of assuming it does.

solarLanesFromAllStations.description: System diagram width counts the lanes of every station record, not just the stations drawn on the diagram.

solarMoonsVisibleOnly.description: The system diagram lists only moons that are visible at system level or inhabited, taken from the moon records, instead of every moon body.

starRecordsFromSystem.description: A star's record is built from the system's primaries alone, with its description (unless the system has primaryDescriptions) and source taken from the system record, instead of copying the system or the star's image record.

starTooltips.description: Each star carries a tooltip describing its stellar architecture and planet count.

stationLinksUseArticleTitle.description: A station's first article link is its system's article title instead of the system name.

stationRoute.description: How the station overview appears in the address: station (station=1), focus (focus=station) or empty for no station overview route.

stormBands.description: Planets with appearance storm-bands are drawn with cloud bands on the system chart.

straightenImageTitleQuotes.description: Curly apostrophes in the article title used for live images are replaced by straight ones.

svgTextSyncedTitles.description: SVG text passes through planetName() so a planet's synced article title is shown instead of its catalogue name.

systemBodyRenderOpacity.description: Bodies in the system chart carry an opacity attribute taken from their renderOpacity (default 1).

titledLocalOrbitLabels.description: The local-orbit accessible labels use the synchronised planet title (planetName) instead of the catalogue name.

titledPlanetInspectLabel.description: The central body of the local planet chart is labelled 'Inspect <synchronised title>' (planetName) instead of the catalogue name.

visibilityResetsLabels.description: Updating visibility also resets every label's display from the labels checkbox before labels are rescaled.

widgetKeepsAddress.description: In widget mode with no system open the address bar is left untouched instead of being rewritten with the current view.

widgetStationOverview.description: A widget can open straight into a station overview from the address.

worldKeySchematicOrbit.description: A world without an orbit slot shows its schematic orbit slot in the system key.
